text: 金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤新德里宣言（摘要）：肯定金砖国家工业渠道7个专门工作组的工作，肯定智能制造和机器人工作组在智能工厂发展、解决方案共享、标准合作和人才培养等方面所做努力
text_en: New Delhi Declaration of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Summit (summary): affirms the work of the 7 special working groups under the BRICS industrial channel, and affirms the efforts of the smart manufacturing and robotics working group in smart factory development, solution sharing, standards cooperation and talent training
